title: "invent_schema"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  collapse = TRUE,
  comment = "#>"
)
```

```{r setup}
library(hercwidpi)
```

```{r}
#| label: find-spec-names

SPEC_NAMES <- data(package = "hercwidpi") |>
    purrr::pluck("results") |>
    (\(.).[, 3])() |>
    stringr::str_subset("^SPEC")

hiRx::print_array_as_column(SPEC_NAMES)
```


```{r}
#| label: find-spec-columns
SPEC_COLUMNS <- SPEC_NAMES |>
    rlang::set_names() |>
    purrr::map(
        get
    ) |>
    purrr::map(
        \(.) tibble::tibble(Column = names(.),
                            Order = seq_along(.))
    ) |>
    purrr::list_rbind(
        names_to = "Specification"
    ) |>
    dplyr::mutate(
        Specification = .data$Specification |>
            stringr::str_remove("SPEC_FOR_") |>
            stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ") |>
            stringr::str_to_title()
    )

SPEC_COLUMNS |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
        names_from = "Specification",
        values_from = "Order",
        values_fill = 0
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
        "Column",
        "Enrollment",
        "Enrollment By Grade",
        "Attendance",
        "Absenteeism",
        "Forward",
        "Hs Completion",
        "Public Hs Completion",
        "Private Hs Completion",
        "Ps Enrollment",
        "Agency Info"
    ) |>
    dplyr::arrange(
        dplyr::across(c(
            "Enrollment",
            "Enrollment By Grade",
            "Attendance",
            "Absenteeism",
            "Forward",
            "Hs Completion",
            "Public Hs Completion",
            "Private Hs Completion",
            "Ps Enrollment",
            "Agency Info",
            "Column"
        ))
    ) |>
    knitr::kable()
```

```{r}
#| label: define-fields
FIELDS <- list(
    Universal = c(
        "SCHOOL_YEAR",
        "AGENCY_TYPE",
        "CESA",
        "COUNTY",
        "DISTRICT_CODE",
        "SCHOOL_CODE",
        "GRADE_GROUP",
        "CHARTER_IND",
        "DISTRICT_NAME",
        "SCHOOL_NAME"
    ),
    Disaggregation = c(
        "GROUP_BY",
        "GROUP_BY_VALUE"
    ),
    Absenteeism = c(
        "ABSENTEE_MEASURE",
        "ABSENCE_COUNT",
        "ABSENCE_RATE"
    ),
    Attendance = c(
        "POSSIBLE_DAYS_OF_ATTENDANCE",
        "ACTUAL_DAYS_OF_ATTENDANCE",
        "ATTENDANCE_RATE"
    ),
    Agency = c(
        "COUNTY_NAME",
        "ATHLETIC_CONFERENCE_CODE",
        "ATHLETIC_CONFERENCE_NAME",
        "WTCS_CODE",
        "LOCALE_CODE",
        "LOCALE_NAME",
        "LATITUDE",

        "SCHOOL_SIZE",
        "VIRTUAL_SCH_IND",
        "TITLE_1A_PROGRAM_CODE",
        "TITLE_1A_PROGRAM_NAME"
    ),
    `Agency or Private` = c(
        "COUNTY_CODE",
        "CITY",

        "LOW_GRADE",
        "HIGH_GRADE"
    ),
    Forward = c(
        "TEST_SUBJECT",

        "TEST_RESULT_CODE",
        "TEST_GROUP",
        "FORWARD_AVERAGE_SCALE_SCORE"
    ),
    `Grade Level` = c(

        "GROUP_COUNT"
    ),
    `HS Completion` = c(
        "COHORT",
        "COMPLETION_STATUS",
        "TIMEFRAME",
        "COHORT_COUNT"
    ),
    `PS Enrollment` = c(
        "INITIAL_ENROLLMENT",

        "INSTITUTION_LEVEL",
        "INSTITUTION_TYPE"
    ),
    Value = c(

        "PERCENT_OF_GROUP"

)

```

```{r}
#| label: what-is-missing

SPEC_COLUMNS |>
    dplyr::pull("Column") |>
    unique() |>
    setdiff(
        purrr::reduce(FIELDS, c)
    ) |>
    hiRx::print_array_as_column()
```
